### Guide #36: US CPSC 16 CFR 1262 Magnet Safety Standard & RoHS/REACH Compliance for Wholesale Fidget Toys
- **Canonical URL**: https://fidgetsupply.com/insights/us-cpsc-16-cfr-1262-magnet-fidget-safety-compliance
- **Category**: Safety & Regulatory Compliance | **Reading Time**: 11 min read | **Updated**: 2026-11-06
- **Featured Ready-Mold SKUs**: FS-075, FS-001, FS-125, FS-013, FS-114
- **Executive Summary**: How FidgetSupply.com engineers mechanical fastener retention, captive counterbores, and thread-locked enclosures so wholesale importers pass US CPSC 16 CFR 1262 and Amazon Seller Central compliance audits.

#### 1. Understanding US CPSC 16 CFR Part 1262 for Magnetic Entertainment Products

Under the **U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) Safety Standard for Magnet Sets and Entertainment/Stress-Relief Products (16 CFR Part 1262)**, consumer products designed for mental stimulation or stress relief that contain magnets are strictly regulated to prevent high-powered magnet ingestion hazards.

Specifically, 16 CFR Part 1262 establishes two fundamental engineering rules for importers and private-label brands:

  - Small-Parts Cylinder & Flux Index Threshold: Any loose or separable magnet that fits entirely within the CPSC small-parts test cylinder (**31.7 mm diameter × 57.1 mm depth**) must have a magnetic Flux Index ($\text{kG}^2\text{mm}^2$) of **less than 50**.

  - Non-Liberation of Embedded Magnets: Because complete metal EDC sliders, coins, and gourds (typically 38 mm to 99 mm wide) are either larger than the small-parts cylinder or house internal magnets inside heavy metal shells, compliance requires that **internal neodymium magnets never detach or liberate** during drop, torque, and tension abuse testing.

Why is this the #1 priority for Amazon FBA and retail distributors?

If a single customer reports that a small Ø5×2mm neodymium magnet fell out of a cheap slider, Amazon's automated safety team can suspend the ASIN immediately pending a 16 CFR 1262 test report.

#### 2. Our 3-Layer Anti-Detachment Magnet Retention Protocol

In low-grade street-market sliders, magnets are glued into shallow open surface dimples with brittle cyanoacrylate superglue that fractures after a single drop onto concrete or hardwood.

Every magnetic model across the FidgetSupply catalog (`FS-001` through `FS-150`) enforces a **3-Layer Anti-Detachment Engineering Protocol**:

  
    
      
        Retention Layer | Engineering Specification | Abuse Test Verification | Protected Catalog Lines
      

    
    
      
        Layer 1: Captive Blind-Pocket Cover Plates | Magnets sit inside internal counterbored blind cavities sealed beneath a CNC stainless steel or PTFE wear plate secured by 2 to 8 M2/M2.5 machine screws. | Zero physical exit pathway even if adhesive is thermally degraded | FS-001, FS-016, FS-094, FS-114, FS-125, FS-150
      

      
        Layer 2: Two-Part Structural Epoxy Bonding | Automated pneumatic dispensing of modified two-component structural epoxy/acrylic adhesive (>22 MPa overlap shear strength, -40°C to +120°C operating range) into chamfered wells. | 48-hour thermal shock cycle (-20°C to +80°C) + 10× 1.5m concrete drop test | All Magnetic Sliders, Coins, Gourds & Spinner Rings
      

      
        Layer 3: Anaerobic Thread-Locked Fasteners | Every M1.6, M2, and M2.5 stainless Torx/Hex fastener and bearing retention nut is assembled with medium-strength anaerobic threadlocker (Loctite 243 equivalent). | 16 CFR 1500.53 Torque (0.45 Nm) and Tension (70 N) clamp verification | Multi-Action Mechanical EDC, Haptic Coins & Gimbal Gyros
      

    
  

#### 3. EU RoHS 3, REACH SVHC & California Prop 65 Metallurgy Standards

Because everyday carry fidgets remain in constant skin contact with the user's fingers and palms for hours each day, chemical and heavy-metal safety is equally vital for US and European retail importers.

  
    
      
        Regulatory Standard | Restricted Substances & Limits | FidgetSupply Raw Material Control
      

    
    
      
        EU RoHS 3 (Directive 2015/863) | Lead (<0.1%), Cadmium (<0.01%), Mercury (<0.1%), Hexavalent Chromium (<0.1%), Phthalates | Virgin Zamak #3 zinc ingots, trivalent chromium passivation, and XRF spectrometer screening on every batch
      

      
        EU REACH SVHC & EN 1811 | 240+ Substances of Very High Concern; Nickel release <0.5 µg/cm²/week for prolonged skin contact | Medical/food-grade SUS304 & SUS316 stainless steel, hard-anodized 6063 aluminum, and nickel-free PVD coatings
      

      
        California Proposition 65 | Total Lead <90 ppm in surface coatings and <100 ppm in accessible substrates; Phthalate-free EVA cases | Lead-free C36000 brass/copper alloys and virgin odorless 85-shore EVA zipper pouches
      

      
        IATA DGR Packing Instruction 953 | Stray magnetic field strength <0.00525 gauss (0.525 milligauss) measured 4.6m from outer carton | High-permeability iron-sheet lined export cartons with pre-shipment flux-gate magnetometer certification
      

    
  

#### 4. Amazon Seller Central Compliance Packets & 30+ Magnet-Free Catalog Alternatives

When listing metal EDC products on Amazon US, UK, or EU, proper age-grading and documentation prevent automated compliance flags:

  - 14+ Adult EDC Age-Grading & Warning Labels: All metal sliders, coins, and spinners are precision kinetic desk instruments graded for **Ages 14+ (Adult Everyday Carry)**. Never list heavy metal EDC sliders in the under-12 children's toy category. Every custom packaging order (Black EVA Zipper Case, Tin Box, or Gift Box) includes free application of compliant 14+ safety warning labels and Amazon FNSKU barcodes.

  - Complete Documentation Packet: Confirmed wholesale buyers receive a General Certificate of Conformity (GCC), 16 CFR 1262 Magnet Retention Test Report, and XRF RoHS Material Verification Sheet.

  - 30+ 100% Magnet-Free SKUs Available: If your distribution channel prefers zero magnet regulations altogether, over 30 models in our catalog contain **zero magnets**—including FS-005 (304 Stainless Knuckle Roller), FS-009 (Knurled Twist Top), FS-043 & FS-066 (Multi-Axis Gimbal Gyros), FS-061 & FS-079 (Chain Sprocket Spinners), FS-063 (316 Stainless Goose Spinner), FS-067 (Bolt-Action Slider), and FS-085 / FS-092 (Mechanical Spring Ratchets).

#### 5. Step-by-Step CPSC 16 CFR 1262 Abuse Test Protocol at Our Fuzhou QC Lab

Before any bulk production lot leaves our Fuzhou Industrial Zone Export Hub, our quality assurance engineers execute a four-stage mechanical and thermal stress audit modeled directly on 16 CFR Part 1262 and 16 CFR 1500.53 abuse testing:

  - Stage 1 — 48-Hour Thermal Shock Conditioning: Random sample units from Magnetic Sliders, Haptic Coins, and EDC Gourds are cycled between -20°C (-4°F) and +80°C (+176°F) to verify that differential thermal expansion between metal shells and NdFeB magnets never weakens the structural epoxy bond.

  - Stage 2 — 10× 1.5-Meter Steel-Backed Concrete Drop Test: Each conditioned sample is dropped 10 times from a height of 1.5 meters onto a 3mm steel plate over concrete across six axial orientations (corners, edges, and flat faces). Passing criteria: zero magnet liberation, zero shell fracture, and zero screw loosening.

  - Stage 3 — 0.45 Nm Torque & 70 N Tension Clamp Test: Threaded M2/M2.5 cover fasteners and rotary bearing caps on models like FS-013, FS-096, and FS-129 are subjected to axial pull and rotational torque to confirm threadlocker integrity.

  - Stage 4 — XRF Heavy Metal & Gaussmeter Stray-Field Scan: Surface coatings are scanned via X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) for Lead (<90 ppm) and Cadmium compliance, while packed master cartons are verified below 0.00525 gauss at 4.6 meters.

#### 6. Customs HS Code 9503.00.0000, Packaging Warning Labels & Non-Magnetic Alternatives

For smooth US CBP, UK HMRC, and EU customs clearance, as well as rapid Amazon FBA receiving, we standardize both customs tariff classification and retail warning labels across all orders:

  - Standardized HS Code & Commercial Invoice Descriptions: All metal fidget sliders, spinners, and desk toys export cleanly under harmonized tariff code 9503.00.0000 / 9503.00.8900 with complete material and magnet safety declarations.

  - Compliant 14+ Adult EDC Packaging Warnings: When you order custom retail packaging (see our Custom EVA Zipper Case & Tin Box Packaging Guide), we print or apply mandatory "14+ Adult Everyday Carry Desk Instrument — Contains Sealed Internal Magnets" warnings alongside your Amazon FNSKU barcode at no extra charge.

  - Explore Pure Mechanical & Bearing Collections: Want to expand your catalog with zero-magnet SKUs? Read our R188 Bearing Spinners & Desktop Gyros Guide and our Multi-Action Mechanical & Ratchet EDC Guide covering 30+ pure mechanical models in Metal Spinners & Gyros and Mechanical EDC Fidgets.

### Guide #37: How E-Commerce Brands & Corporate Gift Agencies Launch Custom Metal Fidgets in 10 Days ($0 Tooling SOP)

- **Executive Summary**: Step-by-step operational playbook for selecting high-margin SKUs (FS-001 to FS-150), avoiding IP/trademark pitfalls, pairing custom laser logos with EVA cases, and calculating landed DDP margins.

#### 1. The 3-Step "$0 Tooling + Custom Logo" Private-Label Launch Playbook

#### 2. Capital Expenditure & Timeline Comparison: Custom Mold vs. Ready-Mold SOP

#### 3. How We Audited & Deduplicated 148 Factory Rows into 140 IP-Safe Models

Raw Chinese factory spreadsheets are notorious for duplicate rows, out-of-stock items, and risky pop-culture nicknames that trigger intellectual-property (IP) bots on Amazon and Shopify.

Before publishing our master catalog (`FS-001` to `FS-150`), our engineering team executed a complete **Catalog Hygiene & IP Sanitization Protocol**:

  - Eliminated True Duplicates & Out-of-Stock Rows: We removed duplicate row #147 (100% identical to FS-135 Spinner Ring) and archived out-of-stock row #65 (Iron Lucky Bead Roller) so every listed SKU is actively producible.

  - Consolidated Multi-Material Same-Mold Families: Rather than cluttering the catalog with separate pages for the same mold in different metals, we merged 6 multi-material families—such as the FS-114 / FS-115 / FS-132 Lake-Light Sword (Zinc Alloy vs. 304 Stainless vs. Zirconium) and FS-105 / FS-106 Celestial Gourd—into unified product pages with interactive material tier selectors.

  - Separated Same-Name Different-Mold Sliders: We distinguished the two different Piano Sliders by their true engineering specs: FS-018 (Compact 16-Magnet Dual-Layer Piano Slider, 60×38×9mm) versus FS-048 (Elongated 32-Magnet Multi-Key Piano Track Slider, 73.5×23×11.5mm).

  - 100% IP-Safe Naming & Clean Unmarked Hardware: All third-party brand nicknames (such as Oreo, Pac-Man, Thor, Elden Ring, or 01EDC) were replaced with clean geometric descriptors (e.g., FS-027 Sandwich Cookie Textured Coin), and all units ship free of unauthorized third-party studio markings.

### Guide #38: Die-Cast Zinc Alloy vs. CNC 304/316 Stainless Steel & PEI (Ultem): Wholesale EDC Cost & Margin Breakdown
- **Canonical URL**: https://fidgetsupply.com/insights/zinc-alloy-die-casting-vs-cnc-stainless-steel-edc-cost

- **Featured Ready-Mold SKUs**: FS-114, FS-105, FS-099, FS-075, FS-038
- **Executive Summary**: Compare Zamak #3 die-cast zinc alloy, CNC 6063-T6 aluminum, 304/316 stainless steel, Amber PEI (Ultem), 3K carbon fiber, and Zr702 zirconium across unit cost, CNC cycle time, retail positioning, and branding methods.

#### 1. Why Two Identical Fidget Designs Can Cost $4.00 or $380.00 to Manufacture

In the global everyday carry (EDC) market, a **$19.99 entry-level slider** and a **$450.00 collector boutique piece** frequently share the exact same dimensions, magnet count, and mechanical linkage.

What separates them is **metallurgy and spindle cycle time**.

Across our 140 production molds, FidgetSupply spans the complete **6-Tier Metallurgy Ladder**—from high-speed hot-chamber **Zamak #3 Zinc Alloy die-casting** ($0.75–$9.00 wholesale) up to 5-axis CNC **304/316 Stainless Steel**, **6063-T6 Anodized Aluminum**, **3K Carbon Fiber**, **Aerospace Amber PEI (Ultem 1000)**, and **Exotic Zr702 Zirconium** ($10.00–$382.00+ wholesale).

#### 4. Why Collector Brands Pay a Premium for Amber PEI (Ultem) and Zr702 Zirconium

If you are building a premium Shopify EDC brand or limited-edition collector drop, two specialty materials consistently sell out at **70%+ gross margins**:

  - Aerospace Amber PEI (Polyetherimide / Ultem 1000): Originally developed for aircraft cockpit instrumentation and medical sterilization trays, PEI Ultem (FS-099, FS-087, FS-090) offers a warm, semi-translucent amber aesthetic that reveals the internal R188 bearings and neodymium magnets while weighing **40% less than aluminum**.

  - Pyrophoric CNC Zr702 Zirconium: Raw Zr702 bar stock costs over **12× more than 304 stainless steel**. Because fine zirconium swarf ignites spontaneously if overheated during milling, our 5-axis CNC centers run slow feed rates under high-pressure flood coolant, followed by hand-polishing and torch flaming at **600°C** to grow a natural black ceramic-oxide (ZrO2) surface skin.

#### 5. Surface Finishing Physics: Antique Electroplating vs. Type-III Anodizing vs. Ceramic Stonewash & PVD

The base alloy determines not only CNC cycle time and unit weight, but also which industrial surface treatments can be applied without peeling or oxidizing during years of pocket carry:

  - Multi-Stage Antique Electroplating on Zamak #3 (Magnetic Sliders & Haptic Coins): Die-cast zinc shells (FS-001, FS-010, FS-017) undergo copper-nickel base plating followed by antique bronze, silver, or gunmetal patination and relieved high-spot buffing to highlight 3D sculptures.

  - Type-II & Type-III Sulfuric Acid Anodizing on 6063-T6 Aluminum: CNC aluminum models (FS-047, FS-064, FS-096) grow an integral porous aluminum-oxide crystal layer dyed in vibrant metallic colors that laser-engraves bright white (see our Laser vs. Silk-Screen Branding Guide).

  - Ceramic Media Stonewashing & Vacuum PVD on 304/316 Stainless Steel: Solid stainless models in our CNC Stainless Steel & Exotic Collection (FS-005, FS-063, FS-075, FS-086) are tumbled in ceramic pyramids to create a scratch-hiding matte stonewash or coated via Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) titanium nitride.

#### 6. How Wholesale Buyers Structure a 3-Tier Metallurgy Pricing Ladder

When pitching corporate accounts or building an online EDC storefront, offering three clear material tiers maximizes both conversion rate and gross profit per customer:

From a supply-chain cash-flow perspective, structuring your catalog across these three metallurgy tiers also balances inventory turnover with halo brand prestige. High-velocity Zamak #3 zinc alloy sliders and coins generate rapid daily order volume and low customer acquisition costs, while mid-tier 6063-T6 anodized aluminum models capture repeat enthusiasts seeking lighter everyday pocket carry. At the top of the funnel, limited-run 5-axis CNC 304/316 stainless steel, Amber PEI (Ultem), and flamed Zr702 zirconium pieces anchor your brand's engineering authority—driving organic social media unboxing videos on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Reddit EDC communities while lifting average order value (AOV) across your entire store.

  - Entry Volume Tier ($14.99–$29.99 Retail | Zamak #3 Zinc Alloy): Use high-detail die-cast sliders and coins (FS-001, FS-027, FS-125) with $0.75–$6.00 wholesale cost to acquire first-time customers at 75%+ gross margins. Die-cast Zamak #3 models in our Custom Logo Ready Wholesale Collection also deliver the lowest unit cost for trade-show giveaways and employee onboarding kits.

  - Mid-Range Performance Tier ($34.99–$69.00 Retail | 6063 Aluminum & Hybrid CNC): Step buyers up to featherweight anodized aluminum and acoustic hybrids (FS-047, FS-096, FS-150, FS-129) across our Tuning Fork Fidget Sliders and EDC Gourds & Hand Pieces hubs. Because 6063-T6 aluminum machines 3× faster than stainless steel while accepting vibrant Type-II/Type-III anodizing, it bridges the price gap between entry die-cast alloys and boutique exotic metals.

  - Halo Collector Tier ($89.00–$599.00 Retail | 5-Axis CNC 304/316 SS, PEI Ultem & Zirconium): Position FS-099 Amber PEI Gourd, FS-148 Stainless Tuning Fork Spinner, and FS-114/115 Lake-Light Sword in Rigid Magnetic Gift Boxes for VIP gifts and limited serialized drops. Adding serialized laser numbering (`001/100` to `100/100`) on CNC 304/316 stainless steel or Zr702 zirconium creates immediate collector scarcity without incurring custom mold tooling charges (see our Zero-Tooling Private-Label SOP and N35 vs. N52 Magnet Engineering Guide).

#### 2. Mechanical Architecture, Tolerance Calibration & Material Metallurgy (Exotic Zirconium (Zr702), 3K Carbon Fiber)

Engineering reliable tactile feedback within CNC Zirconium (Zr702) thermal oxidation, 3K twill carbon fiber lamination, C36000 brass bi-metal contrast, and CNC-pocketed natural abalone shell inlays requires strict control over dimensional tolerances, surface tribology, and mass distribution. In low-grade workshop copies, uncalibrated magnet depth or loose bearing bores create metallic rattle, uneven sliding resistance, and rapid plating delamination within the first two weeks of daily pocket carry. By contrast, when our engineering team manufactures the FS-038 3K Carbon Fiber & Brass 16-Magnet Slider, the FS-084 Multi-Stage Armor Carbon Mechanical EDC, and the FS-091 Abalone-Inlay 56-Magnet Stainless Slider, our factory floor enforces four mandatory production invariants across every batch:

  - Sub-0.02 mm CNC & Die-Cast Datum Tolerances: All bearing seats, hinge pivot bores, track guide channels, and magnet cavities are precision-reamed or CNC-turned to &plusmn;0.015 mm concentricity. This prevents axial bind, lateral plate rock, or premature gear tooth wear on complex assemblies like the FS-094 Abalone-Relief CNC Stainless Rhythm Slider and FS-099 Amber PEI (Ultem 1000) CNC Gourd EDC.

  - Captive N52 Neodymium & Hardened Spring Retention: Every neodymium magnetic array (graded from N45 to N54) and 301 stainless steel leaf or coil spring is mechanically staked, recessed under CNC retaining plates, or sealed inside dual-wall structural chambers. This guarantees 100% compliance with US CPSC 16 CFR 1262 magnet safety standards even under repeated 1.5-meter drop testing onto solid concrete.

  - Multi-Alloy Mass & Moment-of-Inertia Tuning: By combining dense outer rims or sculpted shells with low-friction internal carriers on the FS-014 Machinist Tri-Metal Magnetic Spinner Ring and FS-086 Harmonic-Rhythm CNC 304SS Slider, we maximize rotational momentum, harmonic acoustic sustain, and crisp haptic indexing without causing thumb joint fatigue during extended desk sessions.

  - Surface Hardness & Anti-Fingerprint PVD/Anodized Coatings: All external contact surfaces undergo multi-stage ceramic vibratory tumbling, fine glass-bead blasting, vacuum PVD titanium nitride plating, or Type-III hard anodizing as detailed in our PVD Coating, Hard Anodizing & Stonewash Finishes Guide. This ensures 72-hour salt-spray corrosion resistance against palmar sweat.
